comment: (D) THE WHOLE-TURN PREPAY MUST NOT EAT A MANUAL TAP (USER 2026-10-22: 'The viewer should use exactly the order I give.'). T3, three untapped Forests (#1-#3), hand two Llanowar Elves. The human declares 'tap Forest #1 for {G}, then cast both Elves'. Before the fix BatchPrepayMainCasts ran ahead of the ordered walk and paid both Elves from Forests #1 and #2 (lowest numbers first), so the human's tap of #1 found it already tapped -- 'manual tap SKIPPED' -- and the engine's allocation replaced the declared one. The human's pre-tap must run; nothing may be skipped.
